decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 


1/ The proposed  two storey side extension, first floor rear extension and rear roof extension would, by reason of their disproportionate size, position, design and appearance be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers and harmful to the appearance of the house and the area contrary to the Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan, and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.

2/ The Plans show an extension, which is wider than the space available on the plot.  It would therefore not be possible to build the extension as submitted.  Under the circumstances the Local Planning Authority has no option but to refuse Planning Permission.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, first floor rear extension and rear roof extension to the house together with alterations to the roof of the existing ground floor rear extension
